author: Seung Wook
problem: Given hourly visitor counts, return the largest total number of visitors in any stretch of hours consecutive hours (1 <= hours <= number of hours recorded).
bug_description: When the window slides, it subtracts visitors[i - hours + 1] instead of visitors[i - hours], so it removes an hour that is still inside the window instead of the one that just left.

comments.accurate: Largest visitor total over any window of hours consecutive hours
comments.wrong_behavior: Largest visitor total as the window slides, dropping the second hour of the window at each step
comments.wrong_location: Window update verified; check the initial sum when the list is shorter than hours
